## Your audience
Core buyers are skewed toward the 25-to-34 bracket (strong indexes in 25-29 at 0.42 and 30-34 at 0.32, with Gen Z also engaged at 0.29), while older demographics over 35 index negatively. Gender distribution is balanced with a slight lean toward male buyers.

## Artists & music they love
- **Isaiah Rashad**: 97% match; fits the laid-back, atmospheric West Coast hip-hop aesthetic of your hoodies.
- **Chester Watson**: 94% match; aligns with the underground skate and street culture energy.
- **Joey Fatts**: 93% match; resonates with independent, hard-hitting West Coast motifs.
- **Kembe X**: 93% match; mirrors the gritty, niche underground appeal.
- **Yung Simmie**: 92% match; captures raw underground tape culture.
- **Chuuwee**: 92% match; connects directly to Northern and West Coast street roots.

## Brands they also wear
- **Stüssy**: 88% match; shares foundational roots in West Coast skate and street culture.
- **Undefeated**: 87% match; matches the athletic-tinged streetwear and graphic tee approach.
- **HUF**: 87% match; hits the exact same skate-heavy demographic.
- **Fear Of God**: 87% match; mirrors the appetite for premium oversized hoodies.
- **Billionaire Boys Club**: 87% match; parallels the bold graphic-driven identity.

## Where to pop up
- **Los Angeles, CA**: High-density hotspot covering central LA, the South Bay, and the Valley; prime turf for West Coast skate and street drops.
- **San Francisco, CA**: Captures the Bay Area core spanning SF proper and the East Bay, aligning with Humboldt roots.
- **Portland, OR**: Strong Pacific Northwest concentration perfect for heavyweight outerwear and oversized hoodies.
- **New York, NY**: Major urban East Coast stronghold with heavy affinity for independent streetwear.

## Tour & event tie-ins
- **Isaiah Rashad**: Coordinate a localized pop-up or social push when they play nearby to capture fans of atmospheric West Coast rap.
- **Joey Fatts**: Drop targeted digital promos or invite local tastemakers when they hit tour stops.
- **Chester Watson**: Align skate-park activations or playlist takeovers when they roll through your target metros.

## What to drop next
- Drop a limited-run colorway of the piped nylon tracksuit to test high-intent buyers looking for matching sets.
- Release a heavyweight graphic tee capsule featuring the star "S" emblem to capture lower-barrier impulse purchases.
- Measure success by tracking sell-through velocity within the first 48 hours of drop.

## Marketing moves this week
- Partner with regional West Coast skate accounts on Instagram to style the bold red box logo hoodies.
- Build a Spotify playlist featuring the matched artists to seed directly to your core 25-34 demographic.
- Measure performance by monitoring click-through rates and listener engagement on the curated playlist.
brand: Smacked: an independent streetwear brand from Humboldt County, California. Bold red box logo, a star "S" emblem, oversized hoodies, graphic tees, trucker hats and a new piped nylon tracksuit. West Coast hip-hop energy, skate and street culture.
